title: Suvorexant in Insomnia Co-morbid With Fibromyalgia
brief_summary: This study will compare sleep, pain and daytime sleepiness/fatigue in people with insomnia co-morbid with fibromyalgia while treated short-term with suvorexant 20 mg versus placebo.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* meet Diagnostic and Statistical Manual 5th ed criteria for insomnia
* meet American College of Rheumatology criteria for fibromyalgia
* otherwise good psychiatric and stable physical health

Exclusion Criteria:

* other primary sleep disorders
* pain symptoms unrelated to fibromyalgia
* current pregnancy or breast-feeding
